# An FS that doesn't answer every message offered ends the session, with
# nothing marked: the message stays queued for next time.
@queued P Q9TEST Q2BBS Q1TEST 5_Q1BBS
@calling
< [SAMBBS-0.0-FH$]
< FB P Q9TEST Q2BBS Q1TEST 5_Q1BBS 44
< F> 20
> de Q2BBS>
> FS ++
< *** Error: bad FS line: "FS ++" answers 2 messages, not 1
< *** disconnected
@check accepted=0 forwarded=0 refused=0 pending=1
